description: This file defines the PersistentStorage class, which provides an interface for storing, retrieving, and managing data in localStorage with support for expiration and key management, used within the typeahead.js library.

classes.name: PersistentStorage
classes.description: A class for managing persistent storage in localStorage with support for TTL and key matching.

methods.name: PersistentStorage
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new PersistentStorage instance with a specific namespace and optional override for localStorage.

methods.name: _prefix
methods.description: Generates a prefixed key for storage.

methods.name: _ttlKey
methods.description: Generates a key for storing TTL information.

methods.name: _noop
methods.description: Sets all main methods to no-operation functions.

methods.name: _safeSet
methods.description: Attempts to set an item in localStorage, clears storage if quota exceeded.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from storage, considering expiration.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value with optional TTL.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key and its TTL from storage.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all keys matching the namespace.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if a stored key has expired based on TTL.
